services.desc: If you have a group of 15+ people, we invite you to book a group tour at least two weeks in advance. These one-hour tours are offered on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays and are designed for adults and young people. Please note that we may divide large groups into smaller groups to make sure everyone has an engaging experience. Take a look at the tour topics we offer and book today. Get to know the Gates Foundation-who we are, what drives our work, and how we partner with others to tackle the world’s toughest challenges.
